title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Continues to Break Records Weeks After Its Streaming Debut
content: While the animation studio hasn’t shared any updates on the second installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy, the first movie is still a major hit. The movie hit Japanese theatres in July last year and became a massive hit before its international premiere in September 2025.

title: One Piece Creator Saved Netflix’s Live-Action Series With Big Change During Production
content: It turns out One Piece creator Eiichiro Oda saved the production of Netflix’s live-action series adaptation with a major change to its budget and scripts as revealed by one of the showrunners behind it all.

title: Novelist Ryū Murakami Dies at 74
content: There was a private funeral for family members. Murakami was born in Nagasaki Prefecture in 1952. He made his debut with the novel Almost Transparent Blue , which sold more than 3.5 million copies.

title: After 22 Years, Bleach Anime Ends With Final Episode Timeskip
content: Bleach has officially ended its TV anime franchise with the release of its final episode after 22 long years, and with it gives fans a look at how Ichigo Kurosaki and the others are now living ten years after the fight with Yhwach.
author: ComicBook

title: BLEACH Anime Ends 22-Year Run With Special Ending Movie After Thousand-Year Blood War Finale
content: BLEACH anime has officially ended after a near 22-year run following the release of BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 50. The final episode released on October 27, 2026, while the original BLEACH anime debuted in 2004.

title: Yukari Kaneko's Hanarabeez Original Character Gets 3-Episode Short Anime
content: The official YouTube channel of Shueisha 's Ribon magazine started streaming the first of three episodes for the short anime adaptation of manga artist Yukari Kaneko 's Hanarabeez original character, on Monday.
